cardinality.rule: dataId: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is displaySetId
dataId: if this is a view reference, a render plan layer, an event detail, an actor entry, a stack input or a projection request of Cornerstone, the key is displaySetId
getSourceDataId: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is getSourceDisplaySetId
removeData: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is removeDisplaySet

getActiveDataId: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, never public: on a planar or an ECG viewport getSourceDisplaySetId() gives the same id, and the slide that a whole slide viewport shows has no public getter
setDisplaySetPresentation: a member of a type of the application on a Cornerstone type, its name in 6.0 is setDisplaySetAppearance
